picks.analysis: The Bengals' secondary depth is a key advantage, especially with Dax Hill's impressive camp performance. Detroit's Jahmyr Gibbs is just settling back after contract negotiations, potentially impacting his rhythm. Cincinnati's defensive rotations have been fluid and effective, giving them an edge in containing Detroit's offense.

picks.matchup: Tampa Bay Buccaneers vs New York Jets
picks.analysis: With Vita Vea's hold-in situation resolved, Tampa's defensive line looks formidable against the Jets' uncertain offensive line. Baker Mayfield has been sharp in camp, showing good chemistry with his receivers. The Jets' secondary, led by Minkah Fitzpatrick, has been inconsistent, which Tampa can exploit.

Atlanta's offense is still finding its footing with Bijan Robinson integrating into the system. Denver's defense, highlighted by Marvin Mims Jr.'s camp breakout, has been stifling. Both teams are likely to focus on evaluating depth, leading to a conservative game plan and lower scoring.

Miami's Malik Willis has shown improved deep ball accuracy, which could challenge Washington's secondary rotations. The Commanders are still adjusting their linebacker corps, giving Miami's offense an opportunity to capitalize. With De'Von Achane back, Miami's run game adds another dimension to their attack.

Seattle's defensive line, bolstered by DeMarcus Lawrence's return, is set to dominate against Dallas' shaky O-line. The Cowboys' QB rotation lacks clarity, which Seattle's secondary can exploit. With Pete Carroll's focus on defensive schemes, expect Seattle to control the game's tempo.
